messages:
Zoe: quick idea for the autofallback composer: add a "sanity attenuator" knob. it’s basically a safety multiplier that scales down aggressive fallbacks during incidents. thoughts?
Cal: interesting. how would it behave? example: policy wants 100% switch but attenuator 0.2 -> actually do 20%?
Ravi: yeah, treat it as a multiplier on sample_rate for soft modes and on effective rate for hard-switches. default 1.0, emergency flows can set 0.1. avoids full blast mistakes.
Ella: love that. we should show an upfront explanation and the resulting effective traffic number in the composer preview. e.g., "Requested 80% -> attenuated to 8% (est. 40rps)"
Zoe: UX: place sanity attenuator near sample_rate with a small tooltip "attenuate to reduce blast radius" and a lock icon for org-enforced minimums.
Cal: also add a quick-playback that runs the rule against a short traffic window and shows "would have" counts after attenuation. playback should store snapshot_id.
Ravi: audit: every activation records: event_id, policy_id, attenuator_value, preflight_snapshot, activating_user, and trace_id. fallback-bot should post the audit link.
fallback-bot: autofallback policy afb-2100707777 enabled by Zoe (attenuator=0.2). audit://afb-2100707777
Ella: safety gates: if attenuated effective traffic > org threshold, require an approver. composer shows badge "requires-approval".
Zoe: compatibility: preflight must also include a small sanity check for output-shape differences and a recommended adapter if mismatch. block enable if adapter not possible.
Cal: small sample policy preview (for modal):
```
{"id":"afb-2100707777","triggers":[{"metric":"p95","op":">","val":700}],"mode":"soft-sample","sample_rate":0.8,"attenuator":0.2,"ttl_s":1800}"```
Ravi: tiny nit: store attenuator separately from sample_rate in the normalized policy so UI can toggle it without rewriting original intent.
Ella: final: add a one-line "Why did this request fallback?" in traces that references event_id and shows which trigger + attenuated pct. helps postmortems.
Zoe: i'll mock the UI with the attenuator and playback badge and drop the figma in design. can @Ravi and @Cal review later today?
Cal: will do around 4pm PT.
Ravi: yep, I'll look after the audit schema PR lands.
